description: Answers "is <brand, model or product> free?" from the verified catalog: free (true, false, or null when the name is unknown), a one-paragraph answer with the check date, the best verified offer (main limit, card rule, who qualifies, verified date) and the aifree.dev pages to cite. Unknown names return a search URL. Same record as GET /api/v1/is-free?q=.
name: is_free
title: Is X free?
